stages.title: 01 / Story first
stages.summary: Start here: complete all five chapters and the final mission to establish the story baseline. These 12 story trophies follow the main narrative.

stages.title: 02 / Side missions, strangers & activities
stages.summary: After the opening story beats, work through side strands, stranger jobs and activities as they open. Revisit the map as story progress unlocks more steps.

stages.title: 03 / Collectibles and counts
stages.summary: Once Leonida is open to explore, build progress on meditation, collectibles, vehicles, challenges and Scooter Bros registrations. Visit Lucia’s balcony meditation spot during Chapter 1.

stages.title: 04 / Combat and robberies
stages.summary: With the map and activities available, work through combat trials, stunts and robberies. Leave time for the shooting range golds, vaults and gang operations.

stages.title: 05 / Hidden moments & the Platinum
stages.summary: Finish after the other routes: clear the in-game checklist, discover hidden moments and earn the Platinum once every other trophy is complete.

missables.title: Only missable reported so far: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.text: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and OutputLag report (18–19 Nov 2026) that Lucia’s balcony meditation spot is available in Chapter 1 and gone afterward. Make a manual save at the start of every chapter and before the final mission; the game has no mission replay or New Game Plus.
